description: The chart illustrates ColGC-E performance (in percent) for three LLaMA-2 model sizes under four SFT conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model labels “LLaMA-2-7B,” “LLaMA-2-13B,” and “LLaMA-2-70B,” arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “ColGC-E (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 0 to just above 50 with tick marks at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50. Each model category shows a grouped set of four vertical bars corresponding to the legend: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal hatch) at approximately 4% (7B), 8–9% (13B), and 26–27% (70B); “+ SFT on D₀” (light orange with horizontal hatch) at about 20% (7B), 32% (13B), and 45% (70B); “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal hatch) at about 28% (7B), 37% (13B), and 50% (70B); and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (salmon/pink solid) at about 30% (7B), 39% (13B), and 51% (70B). The bars are grouped by model size with consistent left-to-right ordering of the four conditions within each group, there is no indication of sorting beyond the fixed category order, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond their distinct colors and hatch patterns.
